parser, cli: one Info line says `unique` / `unique0` overlaps are not checked (§3.b unique-overlap-note)

§4.5.586 — ROADMAP §5.2 row 1, §3.b unique-overlap-note (the external
report). Oracles: iverilog 13.0 -g2012, vvp -n (prints `t.sv:6: vvp.tgt
sorry: Case unique/unique0 qualities are ignored.` at compile time, once
per elaborated case site; rejects `unique if`); verilator 5.052 --binary
--timing --assert, run with +verilator+error+limit+1000 (checks the
overlap at run time, once per evaluation); IEEE 1800-2017 §12.4.2 /
§12.5.3 (recalled, no local copy).

Bug: vita does not check a `unique` / `unique0` case or if for more than
one match (a documented cut and a §8 non-goal: the lowered cascade is
first-match-wins), and nothing said so, so a clean log read as "checked":
an overlapping `unique casez` (r = 2'b11 against `2'b?1` and `2'b1?`) ran
the first item, `y=1`, with no line about it, where verilator reports
`[1] %Error: t.sv:6: Assertion failed in t: unique case, but multiple
matches found for '2'h3'` and iverilog prints its sorry at t.sv:6.

The rule:
- One line, `I-PARSE-UNIQUE-OVERLAP-UNCHECKED` / `VITA-I2021`, at the first
  `unique` or `unique0` qualifier of the parse in token order, on case,
  casez, casex, case inside and if. `parse_unique_priority`
  (hdl-parser/src/assertions.rs; its one caller is the statement funnel,
  stmt.rs:165) records it through `Parser::record_unique_qualifier`
  (lib.rs) as `ParseWarnKind::UniqueOverlapUnchecked`. The latch keys on
  the kind, so the first site wins and "once" has one home; one `Parser`
  per parse and no statement-level backtracking, so each qualifier token
  is visited once. Token order is the expanded buffer's: command-line file
  order, `include`d text where it is included, a macro at its call site; a
  qualifier `ifdef`-ed out is not written. A site never reached still
  counts (an uninstantiated module under --top, an untaken generate
  branch, an uncalled function); iverilog prints for the uncalled function
  only.
- `priority` never prints it (IEEE defines no multiple-match rule for
  it), nor does vita's non-standard `priority0`.
- Severity Info: `info[VITA-I2021]`, counted under `notes=`, dropped by
  -Wno-I2021, -Wno-VITA-I2021 or the mnemonic, never promoted (-Werror and
  -Werror=I2021 leave exit 0), exit code unchanged. Not Note: manual 007
  defines a note as the follow-on of the error above it, carrying that
  error's code, and doc15's severity letters are E/W/I/F. Not Warning:
  -Werror would then fail every design with a qualifier (ibex has 123
  `unique case` lines).
- Band 2xxx, because the parse stage emits it; 2004–2020 are reserved in
  doc15 Appendix A, so the number is 2021.
- Location: file:line:col of the qualifier token (`loc_from_span`), the
  line iverilog names (verilator names the `case` line).
- `frontend_pp_to_unit_mapped` (cli/src/frontend.rs) holds the span from
  the parse-warning loop and emits the line after every parse-stage
  return: a preprocessor error, a lex or syntax error and `no design units
  found in source` print exactly PRE's stderr. Anything that fails later
  still prints it: an elaboration error, a duplicate design unit (E2001,
  raised by elaborate), a design with no top module (E3009), a
  -Werror-promoted warning, `$fatal`. W2004 stays ahead of the parse-error
  gate, so it prints before I2021.
- Printed by `vita` and `vcmp`, once per vcmp invocation (the
  work-library flow included); `velab` and `vrun` never parse and never
  print it.
- crates/cli/tests/always_comb_t0_util/mod.rs `diags()` drops I2021 beside
  W1017: both are once per parse and print at `vcmp`, never at a staged
  `vrun`, so keeping it broke 12 pins and `staged_matches`.

No AST, IR, .vu, .velab or SimIr change; format_version 35 unchanged. A
design with no `unique` / `unique0` qualifier never calls the helper, so
its stderr is byte-identical as well. With one: stdout, exit code and
results.jsonl unchanged, .vu and .velab byte-identical to PRE (so is the
run, VCD included); stderr gains exactly one line and `notes=0` becomes
`notes=1`. ibex, the only corpus workload with a qualifier: stdout
digest 13b2ddfcd551ba2f identical, exit 0 (the round-1 POST binary).

Measured (PRE = fc1fc07e release, POST = the round-2 binary, which the
final diff changes in comments and docs only; a lane's stdout and exit
equal PRE's, and its stderr differs by the I2021 line and the notes count
only, unless said):
- native, interp, vm, -q, --log (the line in run.log), --obs-dir
  (run.json differs in timings and utc_unix_s only): one line; interp =
  vm = native. -Werror: the line, exit 0. -Wno-I2021: no line;
  -Werror=I2021: the line; both exit 0 (PRE exit 3: no such code).
- staged multicall and separate-bins vcmp -> velab -> vrun: vcmp 1, velab
  0, vrun 0. Work library (two vcmp --work, velab -L, vrun): one line per
  vcmp. JIT with VITA_JIT=1 and the product build --no-default-features:
  equal to default.
- One line at the expected site: an uninstantiated module under --top, an
  untaken generate branch, an uncalled function, an include, a macro, -D,
  both argv orders, `priority casez` before `unique0 case` (the unique0),
  an elaboration error, a W2004 before the first `unique`.
- No line, stderr = PRE: a syntax error, an `ifdef`-ed out qualifier,
  `priority` only, `q.unique()`, a constraint `unique {}` (E2002, as PRE),
  a source holding only a compilation-unit function on vita and vcmp, the
  four examples.

Review: 2 rounds, differential + soundness lenses.
- Round 1: both PASS, no BLOCKING. Four non-blocking findings, fixed: F1
  the line printed ahead of the `no design units found in source` return
  (a compilation-unit-only source printed I2021, then E2002; now PRE's
  bytes on vita and vcmp); F2 / N1 the comment's "iverilog prints its
  sorry only for a design it compiles" held for parse failures only (an
  elaboration error prints I2021 and iverilog no sorry), so the comment
  and the docs now say which failures print it; F3 a latch keyed on any
  parse warning survived the new file and the workspace gate, so a test
  puts a W2004 select ahead of the first `unique`; P3 the docs filed
  `priority0` under IEEE, now "vita's non-standard `priority0`".
- Round 2 (delta): both PASS; 0 of 29 round-1 runs moved; the lens's two
  mutants (latch on any warning, emit above the no-design-unit return) are
  killed. Text nits fixed: the docs and the frontend comment name E2001
  and a design with no top module as failures that still print the line;
  the `priority0` sentences; an assertions.rs comment that filed
  `priority0` under §12.4.2.

Tests: crates/cli/tests/unique_overlap_note.rs (iverilog and verilator
text above every pin): the whole line; unique0 and unique if; priority
alone silent; the first unique qualifier, not the first qualifier; two
sites, one line; argv order; include, macro, ifdef; a qualifier on its own
line; unreached sites; a syntax error and a compilation-unit-only source
print PRE's bytes on vita and vcmp; W2004 ahead of the first `unique`;
order W2004, I2021, W1017; Info, -Wno-, -Werror, -q; every backend, staged
at vcmp only; `q.unique()`. diag bijection 70 -> 71. Mutants killed: 18,
the 16 of the battery on the new file (the latch on priority too, on
`unique` only, no once-latch, last site wins, emitted inside the pre-gate
loop, Warning, Note, no location, the `case` / `if` keyword span, the arm
deleted, case arm only, if arm only, vcmp drops it, a token scan, emitted
above the no-design-unit return, a latch on any warning) and the
soundness lens's own builds of the last two. Gate: nextest 9048 passed
(PRE 9032), 15 skipped; doctests, clippy, fmt and the product axis clean.

Docs: manual 006 §1.4 (the rule, iverilog and verilator), manual 003 (two
rows), manual 007 (a 2xxx row; 70 -> 71 codes, 3 Info, 34 suppressible;
two stale 68s -> 71), manual 004 (stale 68 -> 71), README (70 -> 71),
CHANGELOG; doc15 entry VITA-I2021 and Appendix A's count.

Out of scope, recorded in PROBE_CATALOG: vita accepts the non-IEEE
`priority0 if` / `priority0 case` (both oracles: syntax error); `logic
priority0;` is E2002 (both accept it); a design-unit lifetime (`program
automatic p`, `module automatic top;`) is E2002 `expected identifier,
found keyword 'automatic'` (both run it). Not chased: an interface-only
design is E3009 `no top module to elaborate` (verilator refuses it too,
iverilog elaborates it: a split); `` `line `` is ignored, so the line
names the physical file like every location (§3.b line-directive);
verilator runs no branch on a `unique if` violation (vita = IEEE's first
match). One line per parse where iverilog prints one per elaborated site
is the row's decision.
